On 16 June 2026, Mbappé scored a brace against Senegal in France's World Cup opening match, reaching 58 international goals and overtaking Giroud as the nation's all-time top scorer.
Mbappé's two goals against England on 18 July brought his overall tally in the competition to 22 across three editions, seeing him overtake Lionel Messi as the all-time World Cup leading scorer.
